brief:
The UN Security Council, established to maintain international peace, has become a forum for managing silence and organizing inaction, Shehab Wire reported. The body convenes, discusses, and issues statements of concern before hitting the wall of Israeli rejection, which renders international law subject to interpretation, the report states.

The council's paralysis leaves victims to face accountability alone, according to the summary, which frames the situation as a reversal of the institution's foundational mandate.

title: Security Council silent as Gaza suffers, Shehab reports
